taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA G5 | Immunopathology & Amyloidosis.

words.clue: Type of immunity that provides immediate, non-specific defence against pathogens
Immunity that develops over days and generates immunological memory
White blood cells such as neutrophils and macrophages that engulf pathogens
System that generates opsonins, anaphylatoxins, and the membrane attack complex
Antigen-specific proteins secreted by plasma cells during humoral immune response
T and B cells that form the adaptive immune response
Professional antigen-presenting cells that initiate adaptive immune responses
Tissue-damaging or functionally disruptive immune reactivity classified by Gell and Coombs
Type I immediate hypersensitivity reaction mediated by IgE and mast cells
Mechanism by which regulatory T cells suppress excess immune responses peripherally
Property of antibodies that improves through maturation during secondary immune response
Medical procedure that exploits the secondary immune response principle for prevention
